candidates.toggle: Also show links with no meaning yet (candidates)
candidates.note: Pairs that appear together but could not be given a relation.

row.noKey: This relation comes from the source. It cannot be confirmed or marked wrong.

error.busy: Please wait until the import has finished.

state.failedSources: Could not read the ledger of {{names}}.
state.loadFailed: Could not read the imported knowledge.

skipped.pair_has_relation: These two terms already have a relation. Mark that one as wrong first.
skipped.cycle: This would form a loop, so it cannot be restored.
skipped.stale: It was already in that state (changed by another action).
skipped.unknown: This row cannot be changed in its current state.

store.line: Confirmed, but could not be placed in the store ({{reason}})
store.failedNote: {{n}} confirmed, but could not be placed in the store ({{reason}}). The confirmation is kept in the ledger.
store.errorNote: The confirmation is kept in the ledger, but placing it in the store stopped partway.

reason.role_mismatch: its role differs from the existing term of the same name
reason.kind_mismatch: its kind (concept / item) differs from the existing term of the same name
reason.cycle: it would make the relations loop
reason.self: it would relate a term to itself
reason.error: an error occurred while placing it

unstated.title: Relation kinds it could not state
unstated.note: Kinds of relation the AI named that are not in the set. You decide here whether to add one as a relation.
unstated.loading: Loading relation kinds it could not state…
unstated.failed: Could not load the relation kinds it could not state.

form.label: Name
form.definitionNote: The AI reads this when it judges a pair (one sentence).
form.examples: Examples (the AI's reasons for pairs of this kind)
form.symmetricNote: Swapping A and B means the same thing
form.toPropertyNote: Only when the other end is a property or quantity
form.fixed: Direction and "B must be an item" cannot be changed once added (it would change the meaning of pairs already set).
form.exact: Standard predicate with the same meaning (IRI)
form.exactOpen: Point to a standard predicate with the same meaning (optional)
form.exactNote: This only points to a standard predicate as "the same meaning". The relation's name in Asterism does not change.
form.exactFailed: Search failed. You can paste an IRI instead.

problem.labelLong: The name can be up to {{label}} characters.
problem.definitionLong: The description can be up to {{definition}} characters.
problem.exactBad: Enter the IRI starting with http(s)://.

added.title: Added relations {{n}}
added.failed: Could not read the added relations.
added.unavailable: Relations cannot be added in this environment.
added.limit: The AI is given only the first {{n}} added
added.exact: Standard predicate with the same meaning:
added.confirmRetire: Once stopped, it can no longer be newly chosen. Pairs already set and their evidence stay.
added.inUse: It is in use, so it cannot be deleted. Use "Stop using" instead.
added.done: Added the relation "{{name}}". The AI can choose it from the next pairs imported. Existing pairs are not asked again
